install: set -eu; if ! command -v gcloud >/dev/null 2>&1; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.local"; curl --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 -fsSL https://dl.google.com/dl/cloudsdk/channels/rapid/downloads/google-cloud-cli-linux-x86_64.tar.gz | tar -xz -C "$HOME/.local"; "$HOME/.local/google-cloud-sdk/install.sh" --quiet --path-update=false --command-completion=false --usage-reporting=false; fi; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"; ln -sf "$HOME/.local/google-cloud-sdk/bin/gcloud" "$HOME/.local/bin/gcloud"; python3 -m pip install -e '.[dev]'
start: set -eu; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.local/google-cloud-sdk/bin:$PATH"; if [ -n "${GCP_SA_KEY_B64:-}" ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/agy-cloud"; printf '%s' "$GCP_SA_KEY_B64" | base64 -d > "$HOME/.config/agy-cloud/agy-ci-key.json"; chmod 600 "$HOME/.config/agy-cloud/agy-ci-key.json"; gcloud auth activate-service-account --key-file="$HOME/.config/agy-cloud/agy-ci-key.json" --project="$GCP_PROJECT" >/dev/null 2>&1; gcloud config set auth/credential_file_override "$HOME/.config/agy-cloud/agy-ci-key.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '%s\n' 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.local/google-cloud-sdk/bin:$PATH"' 'export GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS="$HOME/.config/agy-cloud/agy-ci-key.json"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; fi
